story.hook: Toy taxi, real cab in the puddle!
story.caption_explanation_en: After a warm-night downpour, a street puddle turns a tiny toy into a city cab and our tabby steps up like a traffic pro.
story.overview_ko: 비 온 뒤 야시장 웅덩이에 비친 장난감 택시가 실제 택시처럼 보이고, 고양이가 손짓해 다가서다 마지막엔 반사 속 세계에서만 탄 듯 보인다.
story.continuity_ko: 장소: 비 온 뒤의 서울 야시장 골목; 조명: 네온 간판과 주황색 가로등, 젖은 노면 반사; 날씨: 빗방울 그친 직후의 습한 밤, 바닥은 젖음 유지; 소품: 노란 장난감 택시, 큰 웅덩이, 멀리 풍선 가판대; 시각적 흔적: 물방울, 젖은 발자국, 웅덩이 물결, 반사 정렬 유지.

creative_fingerprint.location_ko: 비 온 뒤의 서울 야시장 골목
creative_fingerprint.twist_ko: 마지막 반사 장면에서만 택시를 탄 모습이 완성
camera_setups: 50mm top-down reflection POV aligning billboard interior

images.camera_strategy: Environmental wide, very low angle just above puddle, 24mm lens, vertical 4:5, cat centered, reflection-dominant composition with neon bokeh and wet street texture.
images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5 frame. Night market after a summer downpour: neon signs and warm sodium streetlights reflect on a glossy wet lane. Foreground: a large puddle occupying the lower half of frame; next to it sits a palm-sized yellow toy taxi on real wet asphalt with tiny water beads. Behind-frame practical billboard across the street shows a full-size taxi side view; from this very low 24mm angle the billboard aligns in the puddle so the reflection convincingly looks like a life-size cab rolling by. Centered and immediately visible: an attractive adult Korean Shorthair cheese-tabby cat; natural balanced sturdy build; bright warm orange short coat with realistic darker tabby stripes; clean white fur on muzzle and chin continuing naturally through neck, chest and belly; all four paws clean white from toes upward; a distinctive congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around the mouth resembling a curry stain, explicitly not food or dirt; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. Keep facial bone structure, fur placement, mouth marking, bright cheese-tabby color, four white paws, eye color, body proportions, age and size identical across all 15 images. Never abbreviate with “same cat” or “previous cat”. The cat stands poised at the puddle edge, weight distributed naturally on wet asphalt, tail balanced, ears up, intent expression. Distant balloon cart and damp paper lanterns hint at the market (soft focus). Realistic reflections and shadows, accurate scale and perspective; individual guard hairs catch rim light; micro droplets on fur tips; subtle atmospheric humidity; natural sensor grain; gentle highlight roll-off. High-end editorial photography. Safety: quiet closed lane, no traffic, everything staged as an optical alignment. Exclude: plastic-looking or waxy fur, excessive HDR, artificial outlines, cartoon/3D looks, fake bokeh, wrong reflections, floating objects, duplicate cats or limbs, human hands, text/logos/watermarks/UI.

images.camera_strategy: Medium shot from sidewalk height, 35mm lens, vertical 4:5, diagonal composition; the cat raises a paw as if hailing, puddle and toy taxi still in frame; moderate shutter for motion blur.
images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5. Same night market lane and weather continuity: wet asphalt, neon and warm streetlight reflections, balloon vendor softly glowing in the distance. The yellow toy taxi remains on the puddle’s near edge, water ripples fanning outward from earlier footsteps. The attractive adult Korean Shorthair cheese-tabby cat (identical appearance and proportions as defined earlier, including the congenital orange curry-like mouth marking, bright cheese-tabby color, four white paws, amber-brown eyes, pink nose, realistic whiskers, short dense fur, slightly rounded cheeks) is now mid-gesture: front right paw lifted like a confident traffic pro, body angled three-quarters, natural balance with hind legs gripping slick ground; whiskers forward, ears alert. The 35mm sidewalk-height view captures the cat big in frame while holding the puddle reflection in the lower third: the billboard taxi reflection streaks past with a slight motion blur consistent with shutter and angle. Small wet pawprints trail behind the cat; raindrops cling to fur guard hairs. Realistic reflections/shadows, accurate scale, physically plausible lighting, natural depth of field. Subtle sensor grain, soft highlight roll-off, restrained cinematic grade. Safety: closed pedestrian alley, no vehicles actually present. Exclude: overprocessed color, glowing edges, cartoonish textures, duplicate animals, human-like paws, text/logos/watermarks.

images.camera_strategy: Unusual viewpoint: top-down 50mm looking straight into the puddle, vertical 4:5; frame the reflection as the main scene while including the toy taxi at the edge for orientation.
images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5. Top-down 50mm shot directly over the same puddle to create a reflection-only portal effect. Practical alignment: outside frame, a backlit print of a car interior door is positioned so its reflection fills the puddle. In the reflection, the full-size cab door appears open and, inside that reflected door, the attractive adult Korean Shorthair cheese-tabby cat (exact same face structure, bright cheese-tabby coat with darker stripes, white muzzle-to-belly, four white paws, congenital orange curry-like mouth marking, amber-brown eyes, pink nose, natural whiskers, short dense fur, slightly rounded cheeks, identical age/size) seems serenely seated on the back seat looking out, tail curled, ears relaxed. In the real world (non-reflection), the small yellow toy taxi sits at the puddle’s rim in the top corner, wet asphalt texture and small ring ripples visible, neon speckles scattered. This creates a clear, satisfying illusion: the toy car and the reflection complete each other. Realistic physics: precise reflection behavior, correct perspective and parallax, subtle water surface texture, micro debris, accurate shadowing from signage. Restrained cinematic color, soft highlight roll-off, subtle sensor grain. High-end editorial realism. Safety: purely optical alignment, no actual vehicles, quiet pedestrian space. Exclude: fake bokeh, plastic fur, HDR halos, wrong shadows, floating props, duplicate cats or limbs, human hands, logos/text.
